description: Electric vehicle charging stations and drivers dataset is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Hyuk-Yoon Kwon. # Data Description ## drivers.pickle - Driver data generated by the simulator - 667210 rows : 3 to 5 per Driver id - 26 columns : Driver, staid, speed, chgerid etc ## meta.pickle - Charging station data - 30895 rows: Each electric vehicle charging station in the metropolitan area - 25 columns : statid, chger ... Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
